body:
My experience with tramadol began 2 years age when I injured my neck in a car accident. I have always found myself attracted to blissful carefree world of opioids, so I found myself rather perplexed when the day that my physician decided to take me off my normal dose of Vicodin, I had been on it daily for a year. He told me he wanted to switch me to a medicine that would be safer on my liver. I was not wanting to do this but then again when it comes to doctors what choice do you really have. Well I came home from his office that day and I decided to at least give this med a chance after all the doctor said it would work on the brain just like hydrocodone, and that he has taken it and found it to even work on his pain longer than Vicodin.
I decided that I would go up to my room and take a hot bathe because I hurt really bad and so I took 3 out of the bottle and drink it with a bottle of water and it was probably about one hour I started to really feel its effects which were similar to vicodin with out the upset stomach. Overall it was a very good buzz.
